nodes.question: What conservation model has seen an increase in popularity in Australia since post-2010?
nodes.answer: The private or non-governmental organisation (NGO)-led protected area model has burgeoned in Australia since post-2010.

nodes.question: Which groups of people are identified as examples of environmental observers in the research?
nodes.answer: Examples of environmental observers include volunteers and employees of environmental organizations, citizen scientists, environmental professionals, and Indigenous knowledge keepers.
